```{r}
rm(list = ls())

library(deSolve)

set.seed(123)

# =========================================================
# 1. SETTINGS
# =========================================================
times <- seq(0, 60, by = 1)

tau_true   <- 20
beta1_true <- 0.4
beta2_true <- 0.15
gamma_true <- 0.1
sigma_true <- 0.01

candidate_tau <- seq(5, 50, by = 1)

state_init <- c(S = 0.999, I = 0.001, R = 0)

nsim <- 2  # Need to increase 

# =========================================================
# 2. SIR MODEL
# =========================================================
sir_cp <- function(t, state, par) {
  
  S <- state[1]; I <- state[2]; R <- state[3]
  
  beta <- if (t <= par["tau"]) par["beta1"] else par["beta2"]
  
  N <- S + I + R
  
  dS <- -beta * S * I / N
  dI <- beta * S * I / N - par["gamma"] * I
  dR <- par["gamma"] * I
  
  list(c(dS, dI, dR))
}

# =========================================================
# 3. SAFE SOLVER
# =========================================================
safe_solve <- function(par) {
  
  out <- try(
    ode(
      y = state_init,
      times = times,
      func = sir_cp,
      parms = par,
      method = "ode45",
      rtol = 1e-3,
      atol = 1e-4,
      maxsteps = 5000
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  
  if (inherits(out, "try-error")) return(NULL)
  
  out <- as.data.frame(out)
  
  if (any(!is.finite(out$I))) return(NULL)
  
  out$I <- pmax(pmin(out$I, 1), 0)
  
  out
}

# =========================================================
# 4. LIKELIHOOD
# =========================================================
nll <- function(p, tau_fixed, y_obs) {
  
  par <- c(beta1=p[1], beta2=p[2], gamma=p[3], tau=tau_fixed)
  
  sim <- safe_solve(par)
  if (is.null(sim)) return(1e12)
  
  mu <- sim$I
  sigma <- max(p[4], 1e-4)
  
  if (any(!is.finite(mu))) return(1e12)
  
  -sum(dnorm(y_obs, mu, sigma, log=TRUE))
}

# =========================================================
# 5. SIMULATION STORAGE
# =========================================================
results <- data.frame(
  sim = 1:nsim,
  beta1_hat = NA,
  beta2_hat = NA,
  gamma_hat = NA,
  tau_hat = NA
)

# =========================================================
# 6. SIMULATION LOOP
# =========================================================
for (s in 1:nsim) {
  
  cat("\n============================\n")
  cat("Simulation", s, "of", nsim, "\n")
  cat("============================\n")
  
  true_par <- c(beta1=beta1_true,
                beta2=beta2_true,
                gamma=gamma_true,
                tau=tau_true)
  
  sim_true <- safe_solve(true_par)
  if (is.null(sim_true)) stop("True simulation failed")
  
  y_obs <- sim_true$I + rnorm(length(times), 0, sigma_true)
  
  cp_profile <- data.frame(tau=candidate_tau, nll=NA)
  fits <- vector("list", length(candidate_tau))
  
  start <- c(0.3, 0.1, 0.1, 0.01)
  
  for (i in seq_along(candidate_tau)) {
    
    tau_i <- candidate_tau[i]
    
    fit <- try(
      optim(
        par = start,
        fn = nll,
        tau_fixed = tau_i,
        y_obs = y_obs,
        method = "L-BFGS-B",
        lower = c(1e-3, 1e-3, 1e-3, 1e-4),
        upper = c(2, 2, 1, 1),
        control = list(maxit = 50)
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )
    
    if (!inherits(fit, "try-error") && is.finite(fit$value)) {
      cp_profile$nll[i] <- fit$value
      fits[[i]] <- fit
    }
  }
  
  valid <- which(is.finite(cp_profile$nll))
  
  if (length(valid) == 0) {
    cat("All fits failed\n")
    next
  }
  
  best <- valid[which.min(cp_profile$nll[valid])]
  best_fit <- fits[[best]]
  
  tau_hat <- cp_profile$tau[best]
  
  par_hat <- best_fit$par
  names(par_hat) <- c("beta1","beta2","gamma","sigma")
  
  cat("Estimated tau:", tau_hat, "\n")
  
  results$beta1_hat[s] <- par_hat["beta1"]
  results$beta2_hat[s] <- par_hat["beta2"]
  results$gamma_hat[s] <- par_hat["gamma"]
  results$tau_hat[s]   <- tau_hat
  
  cat("Finished Simulation", s, "\n")
}

# =========================================================
# 7. CLEAN RESULTS
# =========================================================
res <- results[complete.cases(results), ]

print(res)

# =========================================================
# 8. SUMMARY TABLE
# =========================================================
if (nrow(res) > 0) {
  
  summary_table <- data.frame(
    Parameter = c("beta1","beta2","gamma","tau"),
    True = c(beta1_true, beta2_true, gamma_true, tau_true),
    
    Mean = c(
      mean(res$beta1_hat),
      mean(res$beta2_hat),
      mean(res$gamma_hat),
      mean(res$tau_hat)
    ),
    
    Bias = c(
      mean(res$beta1_hat) - beta1_true,
      mean(res$beta2_hat) - beta2_true,
      mean(res$gamma_hat) - gamma_true,
      mean(res$tau_hat) - tau_true
    ),
    
    RMSE = c(
      sqrt(mean((res$beta1_hat - beta1_true)^2)),
      sqrt(mean((res$beta2_hat - beta2_true)^2)),
      sqrt(mean((res$gamma_hat - gamma_true)^2)),
      sqrt(mean((res$tau_hat - tau_true)^2))
    )
  )
  
  cat("\n================ FINAL SUMMARY ================\n")
  print(summary_table)
  
  cat("\nTau accuracy (±1):",
      mean(abs(res$tau_hat - tau_true) <= 1), "\n")
  
  hist(res$tau_hat,
       main = expression("Distribution of " * hat(tau)),
       xlab = expression(hat(tau)))
}

# =========================================================
# 9. PARAMETRIC BOOTSTRAP
# =========================================================

set.seed(999)

B <- 2 #Need to increase

boot_results <- data.frame(
  b = 1:B,
  tau_hat = NA,
  beta1_hat = NA,
  beta2_hat = NA,
  gamma_hat = NA
)

boot_par <- c(
  beta1 = mean(res$beta1_hat),
  beta2 = mean(res$beta2_hat),
  gamma = mean(res$gamma_hat),
  tau   = round(mean(res$tau_hat))
)

cat("\n================ BOOTSTRAP START ================\n")
print(boot_par)

for (b in 1:B) {
  
  cat("Bootstrap", b, "of", B, "\n")
  
  sim_b <- safe_solve(boot_par)
  
  if (is.null(sim_b)) next
  
  y_boot <- sim_b$I + rnorm(length(times), 0, sigma_true)
  
  cp_profile <- data.frame(tau=candidate_tau, nll=NA)
  fits <- vector("list", length(candidate_tau))
  
  start <- c(0.3, 0.1, 0.1, 0.01)
  
  for (i in seq_along(candidate_tau)) {
    
    tau_i <- candidate_tau[i]
    
    fit <- try(
      optim(
        par = start,
        fn = nll,
        tau_fixed = tau_i,
        y_obs = y_boot,
        method = "L-BFGS-B",
        lower = c(1e-3, 1e-3, 1e-3, 1e-4),
        upper = c(2, 2, 1, 1),
        control = list(maxit = 40)
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )
    
    if (!inherits(fit, "try-error") && is.finite(fit$value)) {
      cp_profile$nll[i] <- fit$value
      fits[[i]] <- fit
    }
  }
  
  valid <- which(is.finite(cp_profile$nll))
  
  if (length(valid) == 0) next
  
  best <- valid[which.min(cp_profile$nll[valid])]
  best_fit <- fits[[best]]
  
  tau_hat <- cp_profile$tau[best]
  
  par_hat <- best_fit$par
  names(par_hat) <- c("beta1","beta2","gamma","sigma")
  
  boot_results$tau_hat[b]   <- tau_hat
  boot_results$beta1_hat[b] <- par_hat["beta1"]
  boot_results$beta2_hat[b] <- par_hat["beta2"]
  boot_results$gamma_hat[b] <- par_hat["gamma"]
  
  cat("Estimated tau:", tau_hat, "\n")
}

cat("\n================ BOOTSTRAP DONE ================\n")

boot_clean <- boot_results[complete.cases(boot_results), ]

print(boot_clean)

if (nrow(boot_clean) > 0) {
  
  cat("\nBootstrap tau accuracy (±1):",
      mean(abs(boot_clean$tau_hat - boot_par["tau"]) <= 1), "\n")
  
  hist(boot_clean$tau_hat,
       main = "Bootstrap distribution of tau",
       xlab = "tau")
}
```


## Bayesian Approach

```{r}
# =========================================================
# BAYESIAN MCMC FOR SIR CHANGE-POINT MODEL
# =========================================================
# This section mirrors the logistic MCMC exactly.
# The only difference: log-likelihood calls safe_solve()
# instead of a closed-form formula.
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 3.1: LOG-PRIOR
# Returns 0 if all parameters in bounds, -Inf if not
# Encodes Uniform priors with biologically meaningful bounds
# ---------------------------------------------------------
log_prior_sir <- function(beta1, beta2, gamma, sigma, tau) {
  if (beta1 < 0.001 || beta1 > 2)    return(-Inf)
  if (beta2 < 0.001 || beta2 > 2)    return(-Inf)
  if (gamma  < 0.001 || gamma  > 1)  return(-Inf)
  if (sigma  < 1e-4  || sigma  > 0.5) return(-Inf)
  if (!(tau  %in% candidate_tau))    return(-Inf)
  return(0)  # log(1) = 0 for uniform within bounds
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 3.2: LOG-LIKELIHOOD
# Solves SIR ODEs for given parameters, then computes
# Gaussian log-likelihood against observed data
# ---------------------------------------------------------
log_lik_sir <- function(beta1, beta2, gamma, sigma, tau, y_obs) {
  par <- c(beta1 = beta1, beta2 = beta2,
           gamma = gamma, tau   = tau)
  
  sim <- safe_solve(par)           # solve ODEs numerically
  if (is.null(sim)) return(-Inf)   # ODE failed — reject
  
  mu <- sim$I                      # model-predicted I(t)
  
  if (any(!is.finite(mu))) return(-Inf)
  
  sum(dnorm(y_obs, mean = mu, sd = sigma, log = TRUE))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 3.3: LOG-POSTERIOR
# log-posterior = log-likelihood + log-prior
# Since priors are uniform, log-prior is 0 or -Inf
# ---------------------------------------------------------
log_post_sir <- function(beta1, beta2, gamma, sigma, tau, y_obs) {
  lp <- log_prior_sir(beta1, beta2, gamma, sigma, tau)
  if (!is.finite(lp)) return(-Inf)
  lp + log_lik_sir(beta1, beta2, gamma, sigma, tau, y_obs)
}
```


```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 4: METROPOLIS-WITHIN-GIBBS SAMPLER FOR SIR
#
# Arguments:
#   y_obs       : observed infected counts
#   init        : named list of starting values
#   n_iter      : total MCMC iterations
#   proposal_sd : named list of proposal step sizes
#
# Each continuous parameter is updated one at a time
# using a normal random walk proposal.
# tau is updated using a discrete random walk.
# ---------------------------------------------------------
run_mcmc_sir <- function(y_obs, init, n_iter = 15000,
                         proposal_sd = list(beta1 = 0.01,
                                            beta2 = 0.005,
                                            gamma = 0.005,
                                            sigma = 0.001)) {
  
  # Storage matrix
  chain <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_iter, ncol = 5)
  colnames(chain) <- c("beta1", "beta2", "gamma", "sigma", "tau")
  
  # Initialize from starting values
  beta1_cur <- init$beta1
  beta2_cur <- init$beta2
  gamma_cur <- init$gamma
  sigma_cur <- init$sigma
  tau_cur   <- init$tau
  
  # Compute initial log-posterior
  lp_cur <- log_post_sir(beta1_cur, beta2_cur, gamma_cur,
                         sigma_cur, tau_cur, y_obs)
  
  # Track acceptance counts
  accept <- rep(0, 5)
  names(accept) <- c("beta1", "beta2", "gamma", "sigma", "tau")
  
  cat("Starting SIR MCMC...\n")
  cat("(This is slower than logistic MCMC because each step solves ODEs)\n\n")
  
  for (i in 1:n_iter) {
    
    # ---- Update beta1 ----
    beta1_prop <- beta1_cur + rnorm(1, 0, proposal_sd$beta1)
    lp_prop <- log_post_sir(beta1_prop, beta2_cur, gamma_cur,
                            sigma_cur, tau_cur, y_obs)
    if (log(runif(1)) < lp_prop - lp_cur) {
      beta1_cur <- beta1_prop
      lp_cur    <- lp_prop
      accept["beta1"] <- accept["beta1"] + 1
    }
    
    # ---- Update beta2 ----
    beta2_prop <- beta2_cur + rnorm(1, 0, proposal_sd$beta2)
    lp_prop <- log_post_sir(beta1_cur, beta2_prop, gamma_cur,
                            sigma_cur, tau_cur, y_obs)
    if (log(runif(1)) < lp_prop - lp_cur) {
      beta2_cur <- beta2_prop
      lp_cur    <- lp_prop
      accept["beta2"] <- accept["beta2"] + 1
    }
    
    # ---- Update gamma ----
    gamma_prop <- gamma_cur + rnorm(1, 0, proposal_sd$gamma)
    lp_prop <- log_post_sir(beta1_cur, beta2_cur, gamma_prop,
                            sigma_cur, tau_cur, y_obs)
    if (log(runif(1)) < lp_prop - lp_cur) {
      gamma_cur <- gamma_prop
      lp_cur    <- lp_prop
      accept["gamma"] <- accept["gamma"] + 1
    }
    
    # ---- Update sigma ----
    sigma_prop <- sigma_cur + rnorm(1, 0, proposal_sd$sigma)
    lp_prop <- log_post_sir(beta1_cur, beta2_cur, gamma_cur,
                            sigma_prop, tau_cur, y_obs)
    if (log(runif(1)) < lp_prop - lp_cur) {
      sigma_cur <- sigma_prop
      lp_cur    <- lp_prop
      accept["sigma"] <- accept["sigma"] + 1
    }
    
    # ---- Update tau (discrete random walk) ----
    # Propose jump of -2, -1, +1, or +2
    jump     <- sample(c(-2, -1, 1, 2), size = 1)
    tau_prop <- tau_cur + jump
    lp_prop  <- log_post_sir(beta1_cur, beta2_cur, gamma_cur,
                             sigma_cur, tau_prop, y_obs)
    if (log(runif(1)) < lp_prop - lp_cur) {
      tau_cur <- tau_prop
      lp_cur  <- lp_prop
      accept["tau"] <- accept["tau"] + 1
    }
    
    # Store current state
    chain[i, ] <- c(beta1_cur, beta2_cur, gamma_cur,
                    sigma_cur, tau_cur)
    
    # Progress update every 1000 iterations
    if (i %% 1000 == 0) {
      cat("  Iteration", i, "of", n_iter,
          "| Current tau:", tau_cur, "\n")
    }
  }
  
  cat("\nDone.\n")
  cat("Acceptance rates:\n")
  print(round(accept / n_iter, 3))
  
  list(chain = chain, accept_rate = accept / n_iter)
}
```


```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 5: FIT ONE DATASET AND RUN THE SAMPLER
# We use the same single dataset approach as the logistic:
# 1. Generate one dataset from true parameters
# 2. Get MLE estimates (use as starting point for MCMC)
# 3. Run MCMC starting from MLE
# ---------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(2026)

# Generate one clean dataset from true parameters
true_par_one <- c(beta1 = beta1_true,
                  beta2 = beta2_true,
                  gamma = gamma_true,
                  tau   = tau_true)

sim_one  <- safe_solve(true_par_one)
y_one    <- sim_one$I + rnorm(length(times), 0, sigma_true)

# Quick MLE fit on this one dataset to get starting values
# (reuse your profile search logic)
cp_profile_one <- rep(NA, length(candidate_tau))
fits_one       <- vector("list", length(candidate_tau))
start_mle      <- c(0.3, 0.1, 0.1, 0.01)

cat("Running MLE profile search for starting values...\n")

for (i in seq_along(candidate_tau)) {
  fit_i <- try(
    optim(start_mle, nll,
          tau_fixed = candidate_tau[i],
          y_obs     = y_one,
          method    = "L-BFGS-B",
          lower     = c(1e-3, 1e-3, 1e-3, 1e-4),
          upper     = c(2, 2, 1, 1),
          control   = list(maxit = 100)),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  if (!inherits(fit_i, "try-error") && is.finite(fit_i$value)) {
    cp_profile_one[i] <- fit_i$value
    fits_one[[i]]     <- fit_i
  }
}

best_one     <- which.min(cp_profile_one)
tau_mle      <- candidate_tau[best_one]
par_mle      <- fits_one[[best_one]]$par
names(par_mle) <- c("beta1", "beta2", "gamma", "sigma")

cat("MLE estimates for starting values:\n")
cat("  beta1 =", round(par_mle["beta1"], 4), "\n")
cat("  beta2 =", round(par_mle["beta2"], 4), "\n")
cat("  gamma =", round(par_mle["gamma"], 4), "\n")
cat("  sigma =", round(par_mle["sigma"], 4), "\n")
cat("  tau   =", tau_mle, "\n\n")

# Use MLE estimates as starting point — chain starts near posterior mode
init_sir <- list(
  beta1 = as.numeric(par_mle["beta1"]),
  beta2 = as.numeric(par_mle["beta2"]),
  gamma = as.numeric(par_mle["gamma"]),
  sigma = as.numeric(par_mle["sigma"]),
  tau   = tau_mle
)

# Run MCMC
set.seed(2026)

mcmc_sir <- run_mcmc_sir(
  y_obs       = y_one,
  init        = init_sir,
  n_iter      = 15000,
  proposal_sd = list(beta1 = 0.005,
                     beta2 = 0.008,
                     gamma = 0.003,
                     sigma = 0.005)
)

# Check tau behavior
cat("\nTau posterior distribution:\n")
print(table(mcmc_sir$chain[, "tau"]))

cat("\nProportion of time tau stayed at 20:",
    mean(mcmc_sir$chain[, "tau"] == 20), "\n")

# Check if likelihood is very different at neighboring tau values
cat("\nLog-likelihood at tau=19:", 
    log_lik_sir(init_sir$beta1, init_sir$beta2, 
                init_sir$gamma, init_sir$sigma, 19, y_one), "\n")
cat("Log-likelihood at tau=20:", 
    log_lik_sir(init_sir$beta1, init_sir$beta2, 
                init_sir$gamma, init_sir$sigma, 20, y_one), "\n")
cat("Log-likelihood at tau=21:", 
    log_lik_sir(init_sir$beta1, init_sir$beta2, 
                init_sir$gamma, init_sir$sigma, 21, y_one), "\n")
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# FULL TAU PROFILE — plot all candidate values
# ---------------------------------------------------------

tau_full   <- seq(5, 50, by = 1)
ll_full    <- sapply(tau_full, function(tv) {
  log_lik_sir(init_sir$beta1, init_sir$beta2,
              init_sir$gamma, init_sir$sigma,
              tv, y_one)
})

# Plot
plot(tau_full, ll_full,
     type = "b", pch = 16, cex = 0.8,
     col  = "steelblue", lwd = 2,
     xlab = expression(tau),
     ylab = "Log-likelihood",
     main = "SIR Profile Log-likelihood over Candidate Change-Points")
abline(v = tau_true, col = "red",  lty = 2, lwd = 2)
abline(v = tau_mle,  col = "blue", lty = 3, lwd = 2)
legend("bottomleft",
       legend = c(expression(paste("True ", tau, " = 20")),
                  expression(paste("MLE ", hat(tau), " = 20"))),
       col = c("red", "blue"),
       lty = c(2, 3), lwd = 2, bty = "n")
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# STEP 6: LONGER CHAIN + BURN-IN + THINNING
# =========================================================

set.seed(2026)

mcmc_sir <- run_mcmc_sir(
  y_obs       = y_one,
  init        = init_sir,
  n_iter      = 30000,
  proposal_sd = list(
    beta1 = 0.005,
    beta2 = 0.008,
    gamma = 0.003,
    sigma = 0.005
  )
)

# Burn-in + thinning
burnin_sir <- 5000
thin_sir   <- 10
raw_sir    <- mcmc_sir$chain[(burnin_sir + 1):30000, ]
thin_idx   <- seq(1, nrow(raw_sir), by = thin_sir)
chain_sir  <- raw_sir[thin_idx, ]

cat("Post-burnin samples after thinning:", nrow(chain_sir), "\n")

library(coda)
ess_sir <- effectiveSize(chain_sir)
cat("\n==== ESS AFTER THINNING ====\n")
print(round(ess_sir, 0))

# =========================================================
# STEP 7: TAU IDENTIFIABILITY ANALYSIS
# =========================================================

cat("\n==== TAU IDENTIFIABILITY ANALYSIS ====\n")

tau_full <- seq(5, 50, by = 1)
ll_full  <- sapply(tau_full, function(tv) {
  log_lik_sir(init_sir$beta1, init_sir$beta2,
              init_sir$gamma, init_sir$sigma,
              tv, y_one)
})

ll_table <- data.frame(
  tau      = tau_full,
  log_lik  = round(ll_full, 2),
  delta_ll = round(ll_full - max(ll_full), 2)
)
cat("Full log-likelihood profile:\n")
print(ll_table)

# Profile plot
plot(tau_full, ll_full,
     type = "b", pch = 16, cex = 0.8,
     col  = "steelblue", lwd = 2,
     xlab = expression(tau),
     ylab = "Log-likelihood",
     main = "SIR Profile Log-likelihood over Candidate Change-Points")
abline(v = tau_true, col = "red",  lty = 2, lwd = 2)
abline(v = tau_mle,  col = "blue", lty = 3, lwd = 2)
legend("bottomleft",
       legend = c(expression(paste("True ", tau, " = 20")),
                  expression(paste("MLE ",  hat(tau), " = 20"))),
       col = c("red", "blue"),
       lty = c(2, 3), lwd = 2, bty = "n")

# =========================================================
# STEP 8: TRACE PLOTS
# =========================================================

sir_param_names  <- c("beta1", "beta2", "gamma", "sigma", "tau")
sir_true_vals    <- c(beta1_true, beta2_true, gamma_true, sigma_true, tau_true)
sir_param_labels <- c(expression(beta[1]), expression(beta[2]),
                      expression(gamma),   expression(sigma),
                      expression(tau))

par(mfrow = c(3, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))

for (j in 1:5) {
  plot(chain_sir[, j],
       type = "l", col = "steelblue",
       xlab = "Post-burnin iteration",
       ylab = sir_param_labels[[j]],
       main = paste("Trace:", sir_param_names[j]))
  abline(h = sir_true_vals[j], col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))



# =========================================================
# STEP 10: POSTERIOR DENSITY PLOTS
# =========================================================

par(mfrow = c(3, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))

for (j in 1:5) {

  if (sir_param_names[j] == "tau") {
    # tau is point mass — show as bar chart
    tau_table <- table(chain_sir[, j])
    barplot(tau_table / sum(tau_table),
            main = expression("Posterior of " * tau),
            xlab = expression(tau),
            ylab = "Probability",
            col  = "steelblue",
            border = "white")
    abline(v = which(names(tau_table) == as.character(tau_true)) - 0.5,
           col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)

  } else {
    d <- density(chain_sir[, j])
    plot(d,
         main = paste("Posterior:", sir_param_names[j]),
         xlab = sir_param_labels[[j]],
         col  = "steelblue", lwd = 2)

    # Shade 95% credible interval
    ci_lo   <- quantile(chain_sir[, j], 0.025)
    ci_hi   <- quantile(chain_sir[, j], 0.975)
    x_shade <- d$x[d$x >= ci_lo & d$x <= ci_hi]
    y_shade <- d$y[d$x >= ci_lo & d$x <= ci_hi]
    polygon(c(x_shade, rev(x_shade)),
            c(y_shade, rep(0, length(y_shade))),
            col = adjustcolor("steelblue", 0.3), border = NA)

    abline(v = sir_true_vals[j],     col = "red",      lty = 2, lwd = 2)
    abline(v = mean(chain_sir[, j]), col = "darkblue", lty = 1, lwd = 1)

    legend("topright",
           legend = c("True value", "Posterior mean", "95% CI"),
           col    = c("red", "darkblue", "steelblue"),
           lty    = c(2, 1, NA),
           fill   = c(NA, NA, adjustcolor("steelblue", 0.3)),
           border = c(NA, NA, NA),
           bty = "n", cex = 0.8)
  }
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# =========================================================
# STEP 11: POSTERIOR SUMMARY TABLE
# Tau excluded from MCMC summary — point-identified
# =========================================================

chain_sir_cont  <- chain_sir[, c("beta1", "beta2", "gamma", "sigma")]

post_mean_sir   <- as.numeric(apply(chain_sir_cont, 2, mean))
post_median_sir <- as.numeric(apply(chain_sir_cont, 2, median))
post_lower_sir  <- as.numeric(apply(chain_sir_cont, 2, quantile, 0.025))
post_upper_sir  <- as.numeric(apply(chain_sir_cont, 2, quantile, 0.975))

sir_posterior_summary <- data.frame(
  Parameter   = c("beta1", "beta2", "gamma", "sigma"),
  True_Value  = c(beta1_true, beta2_true, gamma_true, sigma_true),
  Post_Mean   = post_mean_sir,
  Post_Median = post_median_sir,
  Lower_95    = post_lower_sir,
  Upper_95    = post_upper_sir
)

cat("\n==== SIR POSTERIOR SUMMARY (continuous parameters) ====\n")
print(round(sir_posterior_summary, 4))

cat("\n==== TAU: POINT-IDENTIFIED ====\n")
cat("Posterior of tau: point mass at tau = 20\n")
cat("Log-likelihood drop to tau=19:",
    round(max(ll_full) - ll_full[tau_full == 19], 2), "units\n")
cat("Log-likelihood drop to tau=21:",
    round(max(ll_full) - ll_full[tau_full == 21], 2), "units\n")

# =========================================================
# STEP 12: BOOTSTRAP vs BAYESIAN COMPARISON TABLE
# =========================================================

# Check boot_clean has sigma — if not, use sigma from chain
has_sigma_boot <- "sigma_hat" %in% names(boot_clean)

sir_comparison <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("beta1", "beta2", "gamma", "sigma"),

  Boot_Lower = c(
    quantile(boot_clean$beta1_hat, 0.025),
    quantile(boot_clean$beta2_hat, 0.025),
    quantile(boot_clean$gamma_hat, 0.025),
    if (has_sigma_boot) quantile(boot_clean$sigma_hat, 0.025) else NA
  ),
  Boot_Upper = c(
    quantile(boot_clean$beta1_hat, 0.975),
    quantile(boot_clean$beta2_hat, 0.975),
    quantile(boot_clean$gamma_hat, 0.975),
    if (has_sigma_boot) quantile(boot_clean$sigma_hat, 0.975) else NA
  ),

  Bayes_Lower = post_lower_sir,
  Bayes_Upper = post_upper_sir
)

cat("\n==== SIR: BOOTSTRAP vs BAYESIAN CIs ====\n")
sir_comparison[, -1] <- round(sir_comparison[, -1], 4)
print(sir_comparison)

# =========================================================
# STEP 13: FITTED TRAJECTORY PLOT
# Shows observed data + true curve + fitted curve
# =========================================================

# True trajectory
true_traj <- safe_solve(c(beta1 = beta1_true,
                           beta2 = beta2_true,
                           gamma = gamma_true,
                           tau   = tau_true))

# Posterior mean trajectory
fitted_traj <- safe_solve(c(beta1 = mean(chain_sir[, "beta1"]),
                             beta2 = mean(chain_sir[, "beta2"]),
                             gamma = mean(chain_sir[, "gamma"]),
                             tau   = 20))

plot(times, y_one,
     pch  = 16, cex = 0.7,
     col  = "gray50",
     xlab = "Time",
     ylab = "Proportion Infected I(t)",
     main = "SIR Model: Observed Data, True Mean, and Posterior Fit")

lines(times, true_traj$I,   lwd = 2, col = "black")
lines(times, fitted_traj$I, lwd = 2, col = "steelblue", lty = 2)

abline(v = tau_true, col = "red",  lty = 2, lwd = 1.5)
abline(v = tau_mle,  col = "blue", lty = 3, lwd = 1.5)

legend("topright",
       legend = c("Observed data", "True I(t)",
                  "Posterior mean fit",
                  expression(paste("True ", tau, " = 20")),
                  expression(paste("MLE ",  hat(tau), " = 20"))),
       col    = c("gray50", "black", "steelblue", "red", "blue"),
       pch    = c(16, NA, NA, NA, NA),
       lty    = c(NA, 1, 2, 2, 3),
       lwd    = c(NA, 2, 2, 1.5, 1.5),
       bty    = "n", cex = 0.85)

# =========================================================
# STEP 14: RUNTIME COMPARISON
# Measures computational cost of MLE vs MCMC
# Important for Section 7 of your paper
# =========================================================

cat("\n==== RUNTIME COMPARISON ====\n")

# Time the MLE profile search
time_mle_sir <- system.time({
  for (i in seq_along(candidate_tau)) {
    try(optim(start_mle, nll,
              tau_fixed = candidate_tau[i],
              y_obs     = y_one,
              method    = "L-BFGS-B",
              lower     = c(1e-3, 1e-3, 1e-3, 1e-4),
              upper     = c(2, 2, 1, 1),
              control   = list(maxit = 100)),
        silent = TRUE)
  }
})

# Time 1000 MCMC iterations as a sample
time_mcmc_sir <- system.time({
  run_mcmc_sir(y_obs = y_one, init = init_sir,
               n_iter = 1000,
               proposal_sd = list(beta1 = 0.005, beta2 = 0.008,
                                  gamma = 0.003, sigma = 0.005))
})

cat("MLE profile search (46 tau values):",
    round(time_mle_sir["elapsed"], 2), "seconds\n")
cat("MCMC per 1000 iterations:",
    round(time_mcmc_sir["elapsed"], 2), "seconds\n")
cat("Estimated MCMC total (30000 iter):",
    round(time_mcmc_sir["elapsed"] * 30, 2), "seconds\n")
cat("MCMC is approximately",
    round((time_mcmc_sir["elapsed"] * 30) / time_mle_sir["elapsed"], 1),
    "x slower than one MLE profile search\n")
```
